title: chtypes v1 verified.json (schema 1)
description: The durable record inside one unpacked/sha256/<manifest-hex>/ directory (docs/guides/fetch-v1.md §1): the proof that the directory was verified once. Every binding writes exactly this object and reads exactly this object, so a cache one binding wrote is a cache every binding reads. Every member is present, with null where the schema allows it. READERS accept exactly schema 1 and IGNORE any member not listed here (this schema forbids extra members only because it describes what a WRITER emits). A record that is missing, unparsable, of another schema, or that breaks a rule here is treated as ABSENT: the directory is re-verified from the cache's own blobs, and a successful re-verify replaces the record.

version.description: The exact four-part version, from the verified predicate.

channel.description: From the predicate when it names one, else null.

build.description: The fixed-width UTC build timestamp from the verified predicate.

library.description: The library's file name, relative to this unpacked directory: a plain file name, never an absolute path, never a path with a separator, never . or .. (a cache that moves must still read). The pattern states the separator rule; readers also refuse . and .. .

library_sha256.description: The sha256 of the unpacked library as the installer measured it.

library_bytes.description: The size of the unpacked library as the installer measured it.

index.description: Informational: the index the install was resolved through, null when the install did not go through one (a frozen or pre-seeded install).

bundle.description: The signature bundle's own blob; null only under allow-unsigned.

bundle_manifest.description: Informational: the referrer manifest that carried the bundle, null when the install path never saw it (a frozen install) or under allow-unsigned.

signed_by.description: The key id that verified the signature; null only under allow-unsigned.

predicate.description: The verified statement's predicate, verbatim (under allow-unsigned, the config blob's fields).
